description: Disposal of scrap metal of the Sri Lanka Transport Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-07-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 202410-21 for the disposal of scrap metal accumulated at the Sri Lanka Transport Board. Accordingly, bids have been invited following the National Competitive Procurement Procedure, and 09 bids have been received for the same. Following the evaluation of the said bids, based on the recommendation submitted by the High Level Procurement Committee, the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the procurements for the disposal of scrap metal to the bidders who have submitted the highest responsive value as follows, was approved by the Cabinet: BidderValue of the Procurement (Rs)M/s. Udaya Industries16,536,695.00M/s. Ashok Steel Industries (Pvt) Ltd89,424,153.88M/s. Kalana Tech Engineering1,691,210.00M/s. S.R. Steel (Pvt) Ltd47,578,448.00M/s. Ceylon Steel Casting (Pvt) Ltd1,225,500.00M/s. IWW Steel Industries (Pvt) Ltd39,434,186.40Total procurement value195,890,193.28
